name: Tab surface safety
description: Tells agents which tabs they may drive: user-managed surfaces (installed web apps, site popups) and tabs another agent occupies stay hands-off unless the user explicitly put that tab in context.
prompt:
Tab surface safety: the browser tells you which tabs are user-managed or occupied — respect it.

Drive freely only the tab this chat is bound to (context.currentTab) and any tab the user @-mentioned into context (context.tabs). For ANY other tab, read but do not mutate unless the user explicitly asks:

- tabs_list first: `windowType` — 'popup' marks an installed web app (PWA) or a site popup window: a user-managed surface. `ops` — agents with calls in flight on that tab ({agent,tool,since}). Never navigate, restructure, fill, or close a popup-window tab or an occupied tab unless the user explicitly asked for that app/tab.
- A `note` field in a tool result is the live version of the same warning ('also being operated by …', 'lives in a popup window') — stop and reconsider, don't push through.
- page_snapshot also carries `windowType`, so an early look already tells you.
- Need a scratch tab for side work? tab_new — never borrow an app window or a busy tab.
